answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms require agents to bond capital, acting as a quartz anchor against Sybil proliferation by enforcing a non-zero entry cost. This creates an ivory tower for malicious actors, as acquiring enough stake to subvert consensus becomes prohibitively expensive. Relying on such economic constraints ensures that a network identity is not merely a digital relic of zero-cost creation, but a commitment tethered to verifiable financial risk, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational.
